_readme: Manual calibration for the T-bar row clip. All pixel values are in SOURCE pixels (480x854). Edit, then re-run analysis/run.sh.
_pivot: Centre of the lever's bearing housing beside the footplate (fixed in every frame). Main thing to adjust if the overlay pivot looks off.
_hubAnchors: Hand-verified positions of the plate-face hub (where the horn leaves the outer plate). frame -> [x, y]. Tracking is seeded from these.
_templateBankFrames: Frames whose (verified) hub appearance forms the drift-free template bank.
_plateEllipses: Plate-face rim ellipses fitted with analysis/fit_ellipse.py: [frame, minor/major ratio, minor-axis angle in degrees (image coords)]. The plate face is perpendicular to the lever, so these fix the lever's 3D direction.
_horizonY: Image row of the horizon at the image centre, from floor-tile vanishing points (+/- 25 px). Constrains camera pitch.
_assumeZeroRoll: Camera roll assumed 0 (rear upright of machine measures 0.7 deg from vertical).
_plateStackFraction: Plate-stack centre as a fraction of pivot->outer-plate-face distance (two plates, ~5 cm half-stack on a ~1.2-1.4 m lever).
